1 application Active Job classes were observed (adapter: inline); queued work, retries and mailers do not migrate on their own
Club declares a default_scope; extraction reads through unscoped so hidden rows are preserved, but every behavior that relied on the scope must be re-expressed in the target
Club declares dependent behavior on events, memberships, posts; deletion semantics do not migrate with the rows
Club declares format, inclusion, length, uniqueness validations; ZigBase field options cover only some of these, so the rest need a hook or an explicit decision to drop them
Comment declares dependent behavior on flags; deletion semantics do not migrate with the rows (a cascade decision cannot cover flags: no database foreign key)
Comment declares length validations; ZigBase field options cover only some of these, so the rest need a hook or an explicit decision to drop them
Event is an STI base for MeetingEvent, ReadingEvent on one table; no automatic collection shape exists
Event declares length validations; ZigBase field options cover only some of these, so the rest need a hook or an explicit decision to drop them
Flag declares inclusion, length validations; ZigBase field options cover only some of these, so the rest need a hook or an explicit decision to drop them
MeetingEvent declares length validations; ZigBase field options cover only some of these, so the rest need a hook or an explicit decision to drop them
Membership declares inclusion, uniqueness validations; ZigBase field options cover only some of these, so the rest need a hook or an explicit decision to drop them
Notification.payload is serialized by ActiveRecord::Coders::ColumnSerializer; confirm the target representation
Post declares dependent behavior on comments, flags; deletion semantics do not migrate with the rows (a cascade decision cannot cover flags: no database foreign key)
Post declares inclusion, length validations; ZigBase field options cover only some of these, so the rest need a hook or an explicit decision to drop them
ReadingEvent declares length, numericality validations; ZigBase field options cover only some of these, so the rest need a hook or an explicit decision to drop them
User declares dependent behavior on comments, memberships, notifications, owned_clubs, posts, reported_flags; deletion semantics do not migrate with the rows
User.phone is Active Record encrypted; ciphertext is bound to the source key and never migrates
User declares confirmation, format, inclusion, length, uniqueness validations; ZigBase field options cover only some of these, so the rest need a hook or an explicit decision to drop them
38 client-visible routes were observed; each needs a target (collection API, hook, typed route, or deliberate retirement) and none is derivable automatically
